course.title: Healthy Meal Planning
course.tagline: Plan tasty, healthy meals for the week without stress or waste.

days.title: What is meal planning?
days.goal: Learn what meal planning is and why it helps.

video.title: Meal Planning For Beginners (in 6 easy steps)

steps: Watch the video and write the main idea in one sentence.
Meal planning means deciding your meals before the week starts.
Write down 3 ways it helps: saves time, saves money, eats healthier.
Pick one day this week to plan your meals.
days.task: Write 3 ways meal planning helps you.
days.challenge: Tell a friend what meal planning is in one sentence.

options: Deciding your meals before the week starts
quiz.explain: Planning ahead makes healthy eating easy.

options: It saves time, money and stress
quiz.explain: A plan saves time and money and helps you eat well.
Planning once a week is enough.

days.title: Know your food groups
days.goal: Learn the food groups in plain words.

video.title: Keep Your Diet Simple: A Doctor's Approach to Eating Healthy

steps: Protein builds muscle: eggs, beans, fish, chicken.
Carbs give energy: rice, yam, bread, oats.
Vegetables and fruit give vitamins: spinach, carrots, oranges.
Fats protect the body: nuts, avocado, olive oil.
days.task: List 3 foods from each group.
days.challenge: Name one food from each group in your kitchen.

quiz.explain: Protein builds muscle.
Carbs are the body's fuel.
Vegetables give vitamins and fibre.

days.title: The healthy plate rule
days.goal: Learn the plate rule for balanced meals.

video.title: The Busy Woman's Plate: Masterclass Replay

steps: Draw a plate: half vegetables, a quarter protein, a quarter carbs.
Make one meal using the plate rule.
Take a photo of your plate.
Write down how full you felt.
days.task: Make one meal using the plate rule.
days.challenge: Use the plate rule for dinner tonight.

quiz.q: What goes on half the plate?
quiz.explain: Half the plate is vegetables.

quiz.q: What goes on a quarter of the plate?
quiz.explain: A quarter of the plate is protein.

options: It keeps meals balanced without counting
quiz.explain: The plate rule makes balanced eating easy.

days.title: Plan 3 dinners this week
days.goal: Plan your first 3 dinners.

video.title: Meal Plan with Me + Meal Planning Tips

steps: Pick 3 dinners you like that use the plate rule.
Write each dinner on a card.
Check what food you already have at home.
Write a shopping list for what you still need.
days.task: Write 3 dinner plans on cards.
days.challenge: Write your shopping list for the 3 dinners.

quiz.q: How many dinners should you plan first?
quiz.explain: Three dinners is a good start.

quiz.q: Why check what you already have?
options: So you do not buy food twice
quiz.explain: Checking first saves money.

quiz.q: What should a shopping list have?
options: Only what you need for your meals
quiz.explain: A list stops impulse buying.

days.title: Shop smart: one trip
days.goal: Learn to shop once and buy only what you need.

video.title: Quick and easy meal planning in under 15 minutes

steps: Take your list to the shop.
Buy only what is on the list.
Pick fresh vegetables and fruit first.
Check the date on fresh food before buying.
days.task: Shop with your list and buy only what is on it.
days.challenge: Buy vegetables and fruit first.

options: So you buy only what you need
quiz.explain: A list stops impulse buying.
Fresh food first keeps meals healthy.

quiz.q: Why check dates on fresh food?
options: So you do not buy food that will spoil
quiz.explain: Fresh food with a good date lasts longer.

days.title: Cook in bulk: save time
days.goal: Learn to cook a big pot once and eat it for days.

video.title: Lecture Series - 06 | How to Make a Perfect Diet Plan in Steps

steps: Cook a big pot of rice or stew.
Split it into 3 containers.
Put one in the fridge for tomorrow.
Put one in the freezer for later in the week.
days.task: Cook one big pot and split it into 3 meals.
days.challenge: Eat one of your prepped meals tomorrow.

options: Cooking a big pot once for several meals
quiz.explain: Bulk cooking saves time through the week.

quiz.q: Where should you keep tomorrow's meal?
quiz.explain: The fridge keeps food safe for tomorrow.

options: So each meal is ready to grab
quiz.explain: Portions make healthy eating easy.

days.title: PROJECT WEEK 1: Your 3-day meal plan
days.goal: Put week 1 together: plan and cook 3 days of meals.

video.title: How to Meal Prep a Week of Food in 1 HOUR!

steps: Write a 3-day plan: breakfast, lunch and dinner.
Write a shopping list and shop once.
Cook the meals and use the plate rule.
Write down what worked and what was hard.
days.task: Write your 3-day plan and cook day 1.
days.challenge: Cook all 3 days of meals.

options: Breakfast, lunch and dinner for 3 days
quiz.explain: A full plan covers every meal.

options: It saves time and stops impulse buying
quiz.explain: One shop keeps you on plan.

quiz.q: What should you write down after cooking?
options: What worked and what was hard
quiz.explain: Notes help you improve next time.

project.title: Your 3-day meal plan
project.brief: Plan and cook 3 days of meals: breakfast, lunch and dinner, with a shopping list and the plate rule.
checks: Wrote what worked and what was hard

days.title: Breakfasts that keep you full
days.goal: Learn 3 easy breakfasts that fill you up.

video.title: How To Become A Meal Prepping Ninja

steps: Try oats with fruit and nuts.
Try eggs with bread and vegetables.
Try yoghurt with fruit.
Pick your favourite and make it tomorrow.
days.task: Make one healthy breakfast tomorrow.
days.challenge: Make a different breakfast each day for 3 days.

options: It gives energy to start the day
quiz.explain: Breakfast fuels the morning.

options: Protein and fibre, like eggs and oats
quiz.explain: Protein and fibre keep you full.

quiz.q: What is a quick healthy breakfast?
quiz.explain: Yoghurt and fruit is fast and healthy.

days.title: Lunches you can carry
days.goal: Learn lunches that travel well and stay healthy.

video.title: Healthy Meal Planning Video

steps: Try a rice and beans box with vegetables.
Try a sandwich with eggs and salad.
Try leftover dinner in a container.
Pack tomorrow's lunch tonight.
days.task: Pack tomorrow's lunch tonight.
days.challenge: Pack lunch for 3 days this week.

options: It saves money and keeps meals healthy
quiz.explain: Packed lunch beats rushed fast food.

quiz.q: What makes a good packed lunch?
quiz.explain: A balanced box keeps you full.
Packing at night makes mornings easy.

days.title: Dinners in 15 minutes
days.goal: Learn 3 dinners you can cook in 15 minutes.

video.title: How to make a meal plan on a budget

steps: Try stir-fry vegetables with eggs.
Try beans with rice and salad.
Try grilled fish with yam and vegetables.
Cook one tonight and time it.
days.task: Cook a 15-minute dinner tonight.
days.challenge: Cook a different 15-minute dinner tomorrow.

options: So you cook at home even on busy days
quiz.explain: Quick dinners stop fast-food nights.

quiz.q: What is a fast healthy dinner?
quiz.explain: Stir-fry is fast and full of vegetables.

quiz.q: How long should a quick dinner take?
quiz.explain: Fifteen minutes is fast enough for busy days.

days.title: Snacks that help, not hurt
days.goal: Learn snacks that fill you up between meals.

video.title: Meal Planning For Beginners (in 6 easy steps)

steps: Try fruit with nuts.
Try boiled eggs.
Try yoghurt.
Prepare 3 snacks for the week.
days.task: Prepare 3 healthy snacks for the week.
days.challenge: Swap one sugary snack for fruit.

options: Protein or fibre that keeps you full
quiz.explain: Protein and fibre snacks stop hunger.
Ready snacks stop rushed bad choices.
Eggs keep you full for hours.

days.title: Use leftovers well
days.goal: Learn to turn leftovers into new meals.

video.title: Keep Your Diet Simple: A Doctor's Approach to Eating Healthy

steps: Turn leftover rice into fried rice with vegetables and eggs.
Turn leftover chicken into a sandwich.
Turn leftover stew into a soup with water and vegetables.
Write down one leftover idea for this week.
days.task: Turn one leftover into a new meal.
days.challenge: Use leftovers for lunch tomorrow.

options: They save time, money and food
quiz.explain: Leftovers stop waste and save money.

quiz.q: How long can leftovers stay in the fridge?
quiz.explain: Two to three days is safe for most cooked food.

quiz.q: What can you make from leftover rice?
options: Fried rice with vegetables and eggs
quiz.explain: Fried rice turns leftovers into a fresh meal.

days.title: Plan for a busy week
days.goal: Learn to plan meals when the week is very busy.

video.title: The Busy Woman's Plate: Masterclass Replay

steps: Pick 3 super-quick meals for busy days.
Keep frozen vegetables and eggs at home.
Cook a big pot on Sunday for the week.
Write your busy-week plan on one page.
days.task: Write your busy-week plan.
days.challenge: Cook a big pot on Sunday.

quiz.q: What should you keep at home for busy days?
quiz.explain: Simple staples make quick meals possible.

quiz.q: Why cook a big pot on Sunday?
options: So the week starts with food ready
quiz.explain: Sunday cooking saves time all week.
Eggs and vegetables cook in minutes.

days.title: PROJECT WEEK 2: Your full-week plan
days.goal: Put week 2 together: plan a full week of meals.

video.title: Meal Plan with Me + Meal Planning Tips

steps: Plan 7 days: breakfast, lunch and dinner.
Write one shopping list for the week.
Shop once and cook in bulk where you can.
Follow the plan for 3 days and note what worked.
days.task: Write your 7-day meal plan.
days.challenge: Follow the plan for 3 days.

quiz.q: What should a full-week plan have?
options: Breakfast, lunch and dinner for 7 days
quiz.explain: A full plan covers every meal.

quiz.q: Why shop once for the week?
options: It saves time and stops impulse buying
quiz.explain: One shop keeps you on plan.

quiz.q: What should you do after 3 days?
options: Note what worked and fix what was hard
quiz.explain: Notes help you improve the plan.

project.title: Your full-week plan
project.brief: Plan a full week of meals with one shopping list, cook in bulk where you can, and follow the plan for 3 days.

days.title: Eat well on a small budget
days.goal: Learn to eat healthy without spending a lot.

video.title: Quick and easy meal planning in under 15 minutes

steps: Buy beans, eggs, rice and seasonal vegetables: they are cheap and healthy.
Buy fruit that is in season: it costs less.
Cook at home instead of eating out.
Write down what you spent this week.
days.task: Buy one cheap healthy food this week.
days.challenge: Cook at home 5 times this week.

quiz.q: What is a cheap healthy food?
quiz.explain: Beans and eggs are cheap and full of nutrients.

options: It costs less and tastes better
quiz.explain: In-season fruit is cheaper and fresher.

options: It costs less than eating out
quiz.explain: Home cooking saves money.

days.title: Read labels in 30 seconds
days.goal: Learn to read a food label fast.

video.title: Lecture Series - 06 | How to Make a Perfect Diet Plan in Steps

steps: Look at the serving size first.
Check sugar: less than 5 grams per 100 grams is low.
Check salt: less than 0.3 grams per 100 grams is low.
Compare two foods and pick the better one.
days.task: Compare two foods in your kitchen.
days.challenge: Pick the lower-sugar option next time you shop.

quiz.explain: Serving size tells you what the numbers mean.
Under 5 grams per 100 grams is low.
Comparing helps you choose better.

days.title: Plan meals for your family
days.goal: Learn to plan meals the whole family enjoys.

video.title: How to Meal Prep a Week of Food in 1 HOUR!

steps: Ask each person for one favourite healthy meal.
Plan a week with everyone's favourite in it.
Cook one family meal together.
Write down what everyone liked.
days.task: Ask your family for their favourite healthy meals.
days.challenge: Cook one family meal together this week.

quiz.explain: Meals everyone likes get eaten, not wasted.

quiz.q: What should a family plan include?
quiz.explain: Everyone's favourite keeps the family happy.

options: It teaches children and makes it fun
quiz.explain: Cooking together builds skills and joy.

days.title: Handle eating out
days.goal: Learn simple choices when you eat at a restaurant.

video.title: How To Become A Meal Prepping Ninja

steps: Pick grilled food instead of fried.
Ask for sauce on the side.
Drink water instead of a sugary drink.
Share a large meal with a friend.
days.task: Use one eat-out tip next time you eat out.
days.challenge: Share a large meal with a friend.

quiz.q: What is a better choice at a restaurant?
quiz.explain: Grilled food has less fat.

quiz.q: Why ask for sauce on the side?
options: So you control how much you use
quiz.explain: Sauce on the side lets you use a little.

options: It stops overeating and saves money
quiz.explain: Sharing keeps portions sensible.

days.title: Store food safely
days.goal: Learn how to store food so it stays safe.

video.title: Healthy Meal Planning Video

steps: Cool cooked food quickly, then put it in the fridge.
Keep raw meat away from cooked food.
Use leftovers within 2 to 3 days.
Wash your hands before cooking.
days.task: Check your fridge and throw out old food.
days.challenge: Store tonight's leftovers in a clean container.

quiz.q: How should you store cooked food?
options: Cool it quickly, then fridge it
quiz.explain: Quick cooling and fridging keeps food safe.

quiz.q: Why keep raw meat away from cooked food?
quiz.explain: Separating raw and cooked food stops germs.

quiz.q: How long do leftovers last in the fridge?
quiz.explain: Two to three days is safe.

days.title: Plan for parties and holidays
days.goal: Learn to enjoy events without losing your plan.

video.title: How to make a meal plan on a budget

steps: Eat a healthy snack before the party.
Fill half your plate with vegetables first.
Drink water between other drinks.
Enjoy one treat, then stop.
days.task: Use the party plan at your next event.
days.challenge: Eat a healthy snack before your next outing.

options: So you are not starving when you arrive
quiz.explain: A snack before stops overeating.

quiz.q: What should you fill your plate with first?
quiz.explain: Vegetables first fill you up.

quiz.q: How many treats should you enjoy?
quiz.explain: One treat lets you enjoy without overdoing it.

days.title: PROJECT WEEK 3: Your monthly meal system
days.goal: Put week 3 together: build a meal system you can repeat every month.

video.title: Meal Planning For Beginners (in 6 easy steps)

steps: Write 7 dinners you can cook well.
Write 7 breakfasts and 7 lunches.
Make a master shopping list for the week.
Use the system for one full week.
days.task: Write your 7-dinner list.
days.challenge: Use your system for one full week.

options: A set of meals you can repeat every week
quiz.explain: A system makes planning fast each week.

quiz.q: How many dinners should your system have?
quiz.explain: Seven dinners cover a week.

quiz.q: Why write a master shopping list?
options: So shopping is fast every week
quiz.explain: A master list makes shopping quick.

project.title: Your monthly meal system
project.brief: Build a meal system you can repeat every month: 7 dinners, 7 breakfasts, 7 lunches, and a master shopping list.
checks: Used the system for a week

days.title: Teach someone to meal plan
days.goal: Teach a friend or family member to plan meals.

video.title: Keep Your Diet Simple: A Doctor's Approach to Eating Healthy

steps: Show them the plate rule.
Help them plan 3 dinners.
Help them write a shopping list.
Cook one meal together.
days.task: Teach the plate rule to one person.
days.challenge: Help a friend plan 3 dinners.

quiz.q: What is the first thing to teach?
quiz.explain: The plate rule is the simplest start.

options: Teaching helps you learn it better
quiz.explain: Teaching locks in your own learning.
One simple meal is a good first cook.

days.title: Review your month
days.goal: Look back at your month of meal planning.

video.title: The Busy Woman's Plate: Masterclass Replay

steps: Read your notes from weeks 1 to 3.
List 3 things that got easier.
List 1 thing that is still hard.
Write one fix for the hard thing.
days.task: List 3 things that got easier.
days.challenge: Fix one hard thing in your plan.

options: To see what got easier and what needs fixing
quiz.explain: Reviewing shows real progress.

quiz.q: What should you do with a hard thing?
options: Fix it with one small change
quiz.explain: One small fix keeps the plan going.

quiz.q: What is a sign meal planning is working?
options: Meals feel easier and you waste less food
quiz.explain: Easier meals and less waste mean it works.

days.title: Cook a feast for friends
days.goal: Cook a full healthy meal for friends or family.

video.title: Meal Plan with Me + Meal Planning Tips

steps: Pick a protein, a carb and two vegetables.
Cook using the plate rule.
Set the table nicely and eat together.
Ask everyone what they liked best.
days.task: Cook a healthy feast today.
days.challenge: Ask your guests what they liked best.

quiz.explain: A feast with all food groups is balanced.
Eating together builds joy and connection.

quiz.q: Why ask guests what they liked?
options: So you know what to cook again
quiz.explain: Feedback helps you cook better next time.

days.title: Keep it going: your routine
days.goal: Make meal planning a weekly habit for life.

video.title: Quick and easy meal planning in under 15 minutes

steps: Pick one day a week to plan.
Pick one day a week to shop.
Pick one day a week to cook in bulk.
Write your weekly routine on one page.
days.task: Write your weekly planning routine.
days.challenge: Follow it for one full week.

quiz.q: How often should you plan meals?
quiz.explain: Once a week is enough.

quiz.q: What 3 days should your routine have?
options: A plan day, a shop day and a cook day
quiz.explain: Plan, shop and cook days make the week easy.

options: So you can follow it every week
quiz.explain: A written routine is easy to repeat.

days.title: Plan meals for one person
days.goal: Learn to plan meals when you cook for yourself only.

video.title: Lecture Series - 06 | How to Make a Perfect Diet Plan in Steps

steps: Pick 3 dinners for the week.
Cook double and save half for lunch.
Buy small packs of fresh food.
Freeze what you will not use in 2 days.
Keep a list of your favourite quick meals.
Shop twice a week for fresh food.
days.task: Plan 3 dinners for yourself this week.
days.challenge: Cook one meal and save half for tomorrow's lunch.

quiz.explain: Cooking double saves time the next day.

options: Food you will not use in 2 days
quiz.explain: Freezing stops good food going bad.
Fresh food lasts only a few days.

days.title: Meal planning with friends
days.goal: Learn to plan a shared meal with friends.

video.title: How to Meal Prep a Week of Food in 1 HOUR!

steps: Ask friends what they like and what they cannot eat.
Pick a simple menu: one main, one side, one drink.
Share the shopping list.
Cook together and share the cost.
Write down what worked.
Plan the next shared meal.
days.task: Plan a simple shared meal for 3 friends.
days.challenge: Cook the shared meal this week.

quiz.q: What should you ask friends first?
options: What they like and cannot eat
quiz.explain: Knowing likes and allergies keeps everyone safe.

quiz.q: What is a simple shared menu?
options: One main, one side, one drink
quiz.explain: A simple menu is easy to cook and share.

options: So no one person pays for everything
quiz.explain: Sharing the cost is fair for everyone.

steps: Read your notes from weeks 1 to 4.
List 5 things you learned about meal planning.
Practise your capstone plan once.
Write down any questions you still have.

days.challenge: Write one capstone meal plan from memory.

quiz.explain: The capstone is your final show of skill.

quiz.q: What should you review before the capstone?
options: Your notes from all four weeks
quiz.explain: Reviewing all weeks brings the course together.

quiz.q: How do you know you are ready?

quiz.explain: Planning and cooking a week shows you are ready.

steps: Write your capstone meal plan one more time.
Cook one capstone meal and time it.
Fix anything that felt hard.
Rest well tonight.
days.task: Write your capstone plan and cook one meal.
days.challenge: Fix one hard part of your plan.

options: Practice makes the real run calm and smooth
quiz.explain: Practice turns worry into calm confidence.

quiz.q: What should you check after practice?
options: Your timing, your portions and your list
quiz.explain: Checking timing and portions makes it smooth.

quiz.q: What should you do the night before?
quiz.explain: Good rest helps you do your best.

days.title: Capstone day: your monthly meal system
days.goal: Show what you learned: present your meal system and cook a feast.

video.title: How to make a meal plan on a budget

steps: Show your 7-day meal plan and shopping list.
Cook one full healthy meal.
Explain your system in simple words.
Write a short report on your month.
days.task: Present your system, cook your meal and write your report.
days.challenge: Hand in your report and celebrate.

options: 7 days of balanced meals and a shopping list
quiz.explain: A full system shows real skill.
A balanced meal has all food groups.

options: What you did and what you learned
quiz.explain: A short report shows what you learned.
